### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-6.mdx`  _(via BulkActionResultSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0fea33c6f14ebc1ca6a05494db69ffb4531a22a4` — the merge of head `2244a349ee3b9711bd94bc5a9b0a8886f4b4c7cd` into base `35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0fea33c6f14ebc1ca6a05494db69ffb4531a22a4 && git checkout 0fea33c6f14ebc1ca6a05494db69ffb4531a22a4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796 2244a349ee3b9711bd94bc5a9b0a8886f4b4c7cd && git checkout -B drift-repro 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796 && git merge --no-ff 2244a349ee3b9711bd94bc5a9b0a8886f4b4c7cd

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 35c6331094ad944ddce5d717ffc7015e53ae4796` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在列表里批量勾选记录、执行一个“整批一次处理”的操作后，结果框会逐条说明：哪些成功，哪些失败、各自为什么失败，哪些没有得到确认。以前只要操作没报错，就一律显示“全部成功”。
- 为什么做：处理了一部分、拒绝了一部分时，用户以前会被告知全部成功，被拒绝的记录就被漏掉了。
- 出错会怎样：已有的批量操作，如果返回值碰巧带了“成功/失败”字样却不是规定的格式，以后会显示“结果无法读取”而不是“全部成功”，列表会重新刷新。这一点已在变更说明里写明。
- 要你做什么：不需要你做任何事。它改了对外公开的约定，席位会安排一次约定审核，然后由区域落地。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `8870567d7f353be8d148f9452f0a7b02aabd6b5c` · 2026-11-19T06:48Z

- **形态** — 21 files, +453/−57 (510 lines): `plugin-grid` (executor, dialog, ObjectGrid), 11 `@object-ui/i18n` packs, `count-families` test, `spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` (description text only), two docs pages, one changeset. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 35362`: not governed, under the 3000-line limit. `Clause-②: yes` (three new keys in every published pack), `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Fixes vs card #34269** — `readAggregateResult(value, selectedIds)`:
  - no own `succeeded`/`failed` member → `none` (whole selection covered, as today);
  - a member present but `BulkActionResultSchema.safeParse` fails → `unreadable`;
  - parsed → `rows`.
  In `rows`, `failed` is filtered to the selection, first message per id wins, and an id in both lists counts as failed; `succeeded` is filtered to the selection and duplicates collapse; every other selected id is `unconfirmed`, in selection order. Traced against all five id rules in the schema doc: each holds.
  The executor maps the readings this way:
  - `none` → `succeeded += n`;
  - `unreadable` → `failed += n` plus `aggregateUnreadable`, and the dialog prints no per-row count;
  - `rows` → per-row counts, `errors` carrying the handler's `message` (so it reaches the error CSV), and `aggregateUnconfirmed`.
  So `succeeded + failed + unconfirmed === total`. The surface amendment is real: `runBulkActionAggregate` returned `void`, so no reader could ever be fed. It now returns `readActionPayload(res.data)`, which is the identity on single-wrapped servers and unwraps only the exact legacy envelope. Per-row Retry stays hidden for aggregate defs (`def.execution !== 'aggregate'`), which matches the docs ("re-running the action is the retry"). Count invalidation and the grid re-read on close now also fire on unreadable runs and on runs with unconfirmed rows.
- **Contract text** — the spec diff is description and JSDoc only: the `[PLANNED — not enforced]` marker is dropped and the planned-reader tense becomes present. One rule is added, "an id in `failed` twice keeps its first message"; the reader implements it and a pin covers it. No schema shape changes. The reference page and the `views.mdx` sentence ("a handler that cannot cover the whole selection must reject" is retired) say the same thing.
- **Changeset** — three packages, all patch. Read sentence by sentence against the diff:
  - the reader rules match `readAggregateResult`;
  - "lists each refused row … in the error CSV" matches `errors.push`;
  - "rejection is unchanged" holds (the `catch` arm is untouched);
  - the **Declared behaviour change** paragraph names exactly the `unreadable` arm's population, counts or a single list, and how to keep the old report;
  - the three key names match the packs.
- **Pins** — `useBulkExecutor.test.ts`: per-row count and message, out-of-selection drop, duplicate once, both-lists → failed, first message wins, neither → not confirmed, plus `it.each` tables for the unreadable shapes and the `none` shapes. `objectBulkActionDispatch.test.tsx` runs through the real ObjectGrid dispatch: moved count and failed rows with no Retry; not confirmed is never succeeded; one re-read on close for an all-unconfirmed run; unreadable is never full success; and a CONTROL where a handler returning nothing keeps today's report. `count-families` lists `resultNotConfirmed` as count-neutral, consistent with its sibling `resultFailed`.
- **门禁** — 70 check-runs on this head: 61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failure.
- **接受的偏差** — the surface amendment (ObjectGrid, the count-families test, `views.mdx`) is outside the original fence, but each item is needed for the card's "Done when". It is recorded on the card. Accepted.
- **范围外去向** — none found.
- **L2 owed (routing)** — `Clause-②: yes`, and a non-test file under `packages/spec/src/**` → a contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER is owed before queue. This L1 cannot cover it. Routed to seat 5.
- **落地条款** — base `de8d5497`, main moved K=17 first-parent commits (≥ 15). Main has also landed `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` since the base (all 11 packs, including #35313 on `en.ts`), and this PR adds pack keys. So: merge main and wait for a green re-run before queueing. `git merge-tree` against current main is clean. This ACCEPT carries over to the post-merge head if the merge brings nothing beyond main. After the seat's L2 record, data-2 lands.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a3eb6b24bc65d7819c0ee3f629f505617176d4e5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx

Inputs read: card #34269 (body and all 7 comments), PR #35362 (body, file list, net diff against `main` at this head, 4 comments), and the 75 check-runs on this head: 62 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed. The rest of the diff (11 locale packs, the two test files, `count-families-11445.test.ts`, the two docs pages, the changeset) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set of `BulkActionResultSchema`: unchanged. Right.** The diff in `bulk-action.zod.ts` touches TSDoc and `.describe()` strings only. The shape stays `z.looseObject({ succeeded: string[], failed: looseObject({ id, message })[] })`, both members required.
- **Public surface of `@objectstack/spec`: description text only. Right.** The `[PLANNED — not enforced]` marker is gone from the TSDoc and the describe, the future tense becomes present, and one reader rule is added (first `failed` entry's message wins). The generated reference page `content/docs/references/ui/bulk-action.mdx` carries the same text.
- **Public surface of `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: behaviour only. Right.** The package index (`src/index.tsx`) does not re-export the hook module, so `readAggregateResult`, `AggregateResultReading` and the two new optional `BulkResult` members (`aggregateUnreadable`, `aggregateUnconfirmed`) are internal. What ships is the new result report. Nothing exported is removed or retyped.
- **Public surface of `@object-ui/i18n`: three keys added to each of the 11 packs. Right.** `grid.bulk.resultNotConfirmed`, `grid.bulk.notConfirmedRecords`, `grid.bulk.aggregateUnreadable`. No key removed or renamed. The Test UI shards that run key parity and the count-family test are green on this head.
- **Behaviour change at the consumer: declared, and right.** An aggregate handler whose resolve value has an own `succeeded` or `failed` member that does not parse moves from "all succeeded" to one "unreadable" outcome. The 18.6 text of this schema already announced that rule ("Once read: … reported as unreadable, never as full success"), and review r2 N2 (6907153374) required it in the changeset, where it is, with the two ways to keep the old report.
- **Gate verdicts.** Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, the Lint families and Type Check families: all success on this head.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes — correct. The PR adds three keys to each published `@object-ui/i18n` pack, so the published surface widens. No `(narrowing)` arm is owed: no accepted value, key or export is taken away, and the schema's accept-set is unchanged.

`Metadata-protocol: none` — correct. Nothing a metadata author can write changes: no key, value, default or meaning of authored metadata. `BulkActionResult` is a handler's runtime return value, not authored metadata.

Level: `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@objectstack/spec` — correct under AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 (kind `none` takes `patch`; a non-protocol widening ships `patch`). All three packages the diff publishes from are named; no published package in the diff is missing from the changeset. Both declaration lines are in the PR body and the changeset body, and they agree. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed (kind `none`, no narrowing arm).

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the dev report (7001475210). Nothing to answer.
- Deviation, file surface (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, `count-families-11445.test.ts`, `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`): answered by the claim amendment 7001504622. The `ObjectGrid.tsx` edit is required: without `return readActionPayload(res.data)` the reader only ever receives `undefined`.
- Deviation, pins in the two shared harness files and not in new card-named files: follows the AGENTS.md shared-harness rule the dev cites; accepted by the lane ACCEPT 7001997180.
- Deviation, spec prose adds the first-entry-wins rule: it is the card's own item 2, the reader implements it, and a pin covers it. Accepted.
- Out-of-scope finding (`docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.md` still says PLANNED): internal audit prose that no gate reads; it stays with the seat. The docs-drift check also names the release-owned page `content/docs/releases/v18/18-6.mdx`; that page is read-only for this PR.
- Follow-ups the card already names stay out: skills teaching is #34268; the invocation audit row is a server card the seat files.
- SQL push-down: no finding. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The reader compares the handler's lists with the selection ids the dispatch already holds in memory.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`, against seat ruling 6905490575 (option A, resolve-only), the card's item 2, and its first consumer `readAggregateResult`.** Read sentence by sentence against the code at this head:

- "Read … on every `execution: 'aggregate'` dispatch": holds. The read sits inside `if (isAggregate)` in `useBulkExecutor.ts`, and `ObjectGrid` is the only place that wires `runAggregate`.
- "The object IS the handler's whole resolve value (no wrapper key)": holds. `readActionPayload` is the identity on a single-wrapped answer and unwraps only the exact legacy envelope.
- "Never attached to a rejection; a rejection stays one outcome": holds. The `catch` arm and `aggregateRejection` are untouched.
- "A value with neither member keeps the one-outcome report": holds. `carriesMember` is false for nothing, null, an array, and an object without an own `succeeded` or `failed`; the reading is `none` and the whole selection counts as succeeded, as before.
- "A value with either member that does not parse is reported as unreadable, never as full success": holds. `safeParse` failure gives `unreadable`; the executor sets `aggregateUnreadable`, and the dialog shows its own panel with no count and no success icon.
- "Members beyond the two lists carry no meaning": holds. Both objects are loose, and the reader uses only the two lists.
- "An id outside the selection is dropped": holds, for both lists (`selected.has`).
- "A duplicate counts once": holds (`Map` for failed, `Set` for succeeded).
- "An id in both lists counts as failed": holds. `failedById` is built first and `succeeded` skips any id in it.
- "An id in `failed` twice keeps its first message": holds (`!failedById.has(entry.id)` before `set`).
- "A selected id in neither list is reported as not confirmed, never as succeeded": holds. It goes to `unconfirmed`, is left out of both counts, gets its own tally and list, and is removed from the succeeded list in the dialog.
- "Ids must be the dispatched `params._selectedIds`": holds. `validIds` in the executor and `ids` in `runBulkActionAggregate` are derived from the same rows by the same rule (non-empty `String(row.id)`), so the reader compares against exactly what was dispatched.

Attempts to break it, all held: a `{ succeeded: [], failed: [] }` answer leaves every row unconfirmed and re-reads the grid on close; a failed-only answer keeps the selection and shows each message with no Retry (`def.execution !== 'aggregate'`); `{ succeeded: undefined }` is an own member and reads as unreadable; a legacy double envelope is unwrapped before the read.

**Implementing files.** `useBulkExecutor.ts`, `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `BulkActionDialog.tsx` agree with the contract on every sentence above. Count invalidation and the grid re-read on close also run after an unreadable run or one with unconfirmed rows, which is the safe side.

Findings:

- S1 (should-fix) — the published spec now states two opposite rules. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:3663-3664`, the `bulkActionDefs` describe, still says "Aggregate results are all-or-nothing: a handler that cannot cover the whole selection must reject". This PR makes `BulkActionResultSchema` say a run that moved some rows "resolves with it, a non-empty `failed` being a legal success answer", and it retires that same sentence in `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`. The describe is published text and is generated into `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` (6 rows), `references/api/protocol.mdx` (2 rows) and `references/data/object.mdx` (1 row). On `main` the two texts agreed, because the PLANNED marker said "must still reject"; removing the marker without this sentence is what creates the contradiction. Fix: reword that sentence in `view.zod.ts` to match (a rejection is one outcome; a partial run resolves with a `BulkActionResult`) and regenerate the reference pages.
- N1 (nit) — `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts:752`, the `execution` TSDoc, still says "Result semantics are all-or-nothing: the one call covers the whole selection". Same stale rule, in a TSDoc outside the diff; it can ride S1's fix or a follow-up.
- N2 (nit) — the spec TSDoc names `readAggregateResult`, a function of the hook module that the package index does not export. The package name alone would age better.

No must-fix. S1 is open on this head and earns a delta review of its fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-34269-bulk-result-reader`
Reviewed-by: `isolated-l2-35362`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2244a349ee3b9711bd94bc5a9b0a8886f4b4c7cd`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts + ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/hooks/useBulkExecutor.ts, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/BulkActionDialog.tsx, ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts

Delta review of round 1, record 7002682625 on `a3eb6b24bc65d7819c0ee3f629f505617176d4e5`. The new head is a fast-forward of that one; the delta is 7 files, +23/−19: two spec files (description text only), one `@object-ui/types` TSDoc, three regenerated reference pages and the changeset. No executable line changed, so round 1's reading of the three grid files stands on this head. The 70 check-runs on this head are all finished: 61 success, 9 skipped, 0 failed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-sets: unchanged. Right.** `view.zod.ts` changes one `.describe()` string on `bulkActionDefs`; `bulk-action.zod.ts` changes three TSDoc lines. No schema shape, key, value or default moves.
- **Public surface of `@objectstack/spec`: description text only. Right.** The `bulkActionDefs` describe now says a rejection is one outcome and a partial run resolves with a `BulkActionResult`.
- **Public surface of `@object-ui/types`: TSDoc only. Right.** The `BulkActionDef.execution` comment is reworded; the type is unchanged.
- **Generated pages: in step. Right.** The new `bulkActionDefs` sentence is in all 9 reference rows (`references/ui/view.mdx` 6, `references/api/protocol.mdx` 2, `references/data/object.mdx` 1) and the old sentence is in none.
- Round 1's other judgments are unchanged by this delta.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes — unchanged and correct (three keys added to each published `@object-ui/i18n` pack). `Metadata-protocol: none` — still correct: the delta is description text.

The new `'@object-ui/types': patch` entry is right. The diff now changes a file that package publishes (the TSDoc ships in its type declarations), so it owes a changeset, and kind `none` takes `patch`. The changeset now names all four packages the diff publishes from, and its body states the wording change in both places.

### ③ Boundary flags

- No new dev flag and no `open_questions` entry in this delta.
- `view.zod.ts` is a second published-spec file, so it joins the `hits` scope above.
- SQL push-down: no finding. The delta contains no code.
- Round 1's answers stand.

### ④ Design judgment

- S1: closed. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` no longer says "all-or-nothing … must reject". Its new sentence agrees with `BulkActionResultSchema` and with the reader: a rejection is one outcome (`aggregateRejection`), a partial run resolves with `{ succeeded, failed }`, a non-empty `failed` is a success answer, and per-row retry is replaced by re-running the action (the dialog hides Retry for an aggregate def).
